criteria.label: Demand & Intent
criteria.description: Evidence that people actively search for and want to buy this product
fixSuggestions: Run Google Trends analysis for product keywords
Check Amazon Best Sellers in category
Test with $50 Facebook ad to measure click-through
Survey 20 potential customers about purchase intent

criteria.label: Differentiation
criteria.description: Clear reason why customers would buy from you vs Amazon/competitors
riskIndicators: Commodity product with no unique angle
Can be easily found on Amazon for less
No brand story or emotional hook
fixSuggestions: Identify 1 specific customer pain point competitors ignore
Create a brand story tied to founder experience
Bundle products in a unique way
Target an underserved niche segment

criteria.label: Unit Economics
criteria.description: Margin after COGS, shipping, returns, and customer acquisition
fixSuggestions: Get 3 supplier quotes for exact COGS
Calculate all-in shipping cost per unit
Model 15% return rate and restock costs
Target minimum 3x markup before ads

criteria.label: Operations & Fulfillment
criteria.description: Ability to reliably fulfill orders at scale
fixSuggestions: Choose fulfillment model: self, 3PL, or dropship
Identify backup supplier
Start with limited SKU count (under 10)
Use local fulfillment first before international

criteria.label: Distribution Channels
criteria.description: Clear path to reach customers profitably
fixSuggestions: Pick ONE primary channel to master first
Test UGC content before scaling ads
Build email list from day 1
Identify 5 micro-influencers in niche

failurePatterns.description: Selling generic products that Amazon or competitors offer cheaper
Unit economics don't support profitable customer acquisition
Large upfront inventory investment before demand validation
